relationships.subject: USP5 R24W
relationships.evidence_quote: mutant USP5 exhibits a dramatic reduction in enzymatic activity but stronger interactions with Cav3.2

relationships.subject: USP5 R24W
relationships.evidence_quote: R24W mutant USP5 is a critical regulator of chronic and acute pain states in humans by acting as a dominant-negative regulator of Cav3.2

key_findings: USP5 R24W in a pain-insensitive patient; knock-in mice resist acute pain and thermal hypersensitivity in chronic pain models.
R24W mice lack CFA-induced upregulation of Cav3.2 and USP5.
